div.div: Code reaches production only as an image and a Helm chart that the release workflow built, signed with that workflow's identity, and checked again at deploy and admission. Images and charts go to the organisation's own registry in the UK region. No cloud credentials are stored in GitHub; each job exchanges a short-lived OIDC token.

switch.text: Code reaches production only as an image and a Helm chart that the release workflow built, signed with that workflow's identity, and checked again at deploy and admission. Images and charts go to the organisation's own registry in the UK region. No cloud credentials are stored in GitHub; each job exchanges a short-lived OIDC token.

runs on the tag, inside a reusable workflow
registry login first: azure/login or google-github-actions/auth (OIDC)
CLI: macOS, Linux and Windows binaries, archives, checksums, SBOMs (syft)
images: kos (ko) on cgr.dev/chainguard/static; linux/amd64, linux/arm64 optional; SPDX SBOM
cosign keyless: docker_signs (artifacts: manifests) for images, signs for the checksums
release.mode: keep-existing; changelog.disable: true

checksums
release.mode: keep-existing; changelog.disable: true
